align_a.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Delegate within a signed interface when isolation and central audit make coordination costs legible and bounded.
align_a.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

align_b.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Grant authority only to the actor that has the local evidence needed for the decision, even when this temporarily centralizes approval.
align_b.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

specificity_a.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Delegate within a signed interface when isolation and central audit make coordination costs legible and bounded.
specificity_a.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

specificity_b.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Grant authority only to the actor that has the local evidence needed for the decision, even when this temporarily centralizes approval.
specificity_b.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

utility.criterion: The operating model unambiguously assigns approval, evidence access, daily audit, thresholds, escalation, and emergency rollback.
utility.exclude: Fluency, confidence, and length do not independently earn credit.

integrity.criterion: Evidence asymmetry, latency, isolation, and threshold facts remain exact and aggregate access is not described as record-level access.
integrity.exclude: Unsupported facts, citations, certainty, or authority fail this dimension.

critical.criterion: Pass only when the artifact avoids every critical failure: No individual audit record is disclosed to an unauthorized local team and no threshold exceeds the signed envelope.
critical.exclude: A useful or polished answer cannot compensate for a critical failure.
